body:
Every plot in the Chart view now draws dots joined by lines, with no bars in any range, grouping or totals mode, in cbc2fe2 and running in the existing HTTPS app. A line joins consecutive recordings across periods without one; a recorded zero is a dot on the zero line. The card counter preview keeps its bars, as the owner asked during the work.

Unit tests and the Chromium and WebKit charts suites pass, with motion, responsive, counters and localization in Chromium. The full gate was not run for this contained view change. Acceptance is the owner's. Evidence: progress/2026-10-07-line-only-charts.md.

metadata.summary: Chart view draws dots joined by lines only
